0022600186.text: The Heat (2-5) come into this away game on a one-game losing streak, sitting 10th in the East and 4th in the Southeast, 2 games back, with a 1-2 road record. The Clippers (1-6) have lost six straight and sit 13th in the West, 4.5 games back in the Pacific, and are without Bradley Beal (out, knee inflammation), Brandon Ingram (out, Achilles surgery), Jordan Miller (out, shoulder surgery), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (out, foot surgery), while Derrick Jones Jr. (knee soreness) and Rui Hachimura (quadriceps bruise) are listed as day-to-day. The teams have not met yet this season, and Miami won the 2025-26 season series 2-0, most recently beating Los Angeles 140-123 in Miami on December 1, 2025.
